pages.title: The Great Dao of Forging
pages.text: Cultivators refine their bodies with spiritual energy, while artifact masters refine the treasures of the world with heavenly flames. Though their paths differ, both seek transformation beyond mortal limits.

pages.title: The Great Dao of Forging
pages.text: Materials form the bones, flames become the blood, spiritual patterns serve as the meridians, and Qi gives the artifact its spirit.

pages.title: The Great Dao of Forging
pages.text: The greatest weapons are not necessarily forged with the fiercest fire or the rarest metals. They are born through knowledge, patience, and perfect mastery of the refining process.
